subject: Re: Kickoff: DrJAX as our parallel-computation authoring layer
body:
Zofia,

Status on the setup plus resourcing.

Staffing: Yusuf leads the technical adoption and the differentiability test coverage, Paloma owns packaging/CI (wheel builds via python -m build are green as of Friday, run_test.sh wired into CI), Tereza and Rosa split the two pilot migrations.

Compute: adoption work itself is cheap — correctness runs on small titan slices; the pilots bring their own training budgets.

New scoped build: to prove the migrations don't regress anything, we need side-by-side correctness and performance comparisons run continuously, so we're scoping and staffing an internal evaluation harness built from scratch — Rosa leads at 50% from April 20, covering benchmark definitions, sharded-vs-baseline numerical diffing, and scheduled regression runs with a report artifact. Nothing off the shelf fits the differentiable-communication cases, so I've budgeted six engineer-weeks, targeting a working harness by June 1.

Jelena
